what_happened.line: The chair said the manager was made exempt without the salary adjustment the committee's motion called for, and that he is working to resolve it.
The committee discussed an Xfinity letter about a channel change that never reached it; the letter packet will be held at the station for a member to collect.
The prior meeting's minutes were approved with spelling corrections; the minutes record no roll-call vote.
The manager reported staff are reviewing lists for identical videographer camera kits to be bought with ARPA money, and that new backup drives were bought.
The next meeting was set for six o'clock in January, with the date heard as the 8th.

why_it_matters: The committee oversees the cable access station, and its ARPA purchases (cameras, audio, storage) and the manager's pay classification are paid for from public money and set by its votes.
The November Comcast payment was not yet posted, so the financials the committee reviewed did not include it.
watch_next: The January meeting at six o'clock (date heard as the 8th) and whether the manager's exempt status and salary adjustment are resolved.
The February review of the enterprise fund investment status.
